verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management platform, so AI-driven code diff decomposition is a code-review axis outside its category. Nothing in the evidence shows Asana analyzing diffs. Its GitHub integration only syncs pull request status to tasks, and its AI Teammates and MCP features operate on Work Graph task data, not code changes.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
